reason: The README describes a persistent handoff and project-knowledge system that records session turns, summarizes them, and injects branch-specific context into future sessions.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 持久化每个 Git 分支的交接记录、项目知识和规则，并将相关上下文注入后续会话。
summaries.en: Persists per-branch handoffs, shared project knowledge, and pinned rules for DeepSeek Harness, then injects the relevant context into future sessions.

capabilities: Persists branch handoffs and shared project knowledge in files under the user home directory
Injects stored handoff and project context into future sessions
Provides user commands and an agent tool for inspecting and updating stored context
Periodically summarizes recorded material into Markdown
